note: Agent kit scan: per-ability corrections to the parsed kit (engine/src/kit-index.ts), each checked against the catalog ability text whose hash is stored; npm run kit:index applies an entry only while the hash still matches.

adele.note: Q Royal Flourish 'Mesmerize' kept as sleep (no mesmerize type in the list). E Iron Rose is a damage-reduction 'barrier', not a damage-absorbing shield; shield=true kept as parsed. R vine pull only drags flying enemies to the ground (pull kept; could arguably be 'ground').

akeron.note: E Web Lash Root/Stun rise to 1.25s only while Awakened; hardSec kept at the base 1. R Consume pulls for up to 3s as a channel; hardSec left null. Passive only increases healing (no restore), so heal set false.

argus.note: R Synaptic Obliterator only grants Argus immunity to pushes and pulls; it applies no push/pull to enemies.

aurora.note: Q leap removed: the airborne jump belongs to the passive. Passive only lowers its cooldown when Aurora immobilizes a hero; it applies no root.

bayle.note: R Kingslayer throws the target into the air for 8 strikes; no CC duration stated, so hardSec left null.

boris.note: R Ursine Burst 'Grab' carries the hero and slams them; kept as pull. E Primeval Roar is damage reduction, not a shield; shield left false.

countess.note: Q re-trigger swaps places with the Shadow (instant reposition), added as blink.

dekker.note: E Containment Fence blocks enemy heroes but is not a listed CC type; left empty.

drongo.note: R in-air cast launches Drongo backwards; added as leap (airborne launch, could be read as dash).

eden.note: LMB, RMB, Q and R have empty game_description; read from menu_description. Melee Talon Drive 'uppercutting' may be a knockup but no CC tag or duration is stated, so no hard CC added.

feng-mao.note: RMB Reaping Dash: game text says Blink, menu says Dash; both kept. Q Safeguard Spellshield blocks an ability but is not a damage shield; shield kept false.

gideon.note: E Torn Space 'leaps through a portal, appearing at the target location'; kept as leap though it may be a blink. Passive Cosmic Tether is a damage link that ends in a root, not a movement tether; kept as root only.

greystone.note: Passive Stoicism grants Health Regen (scaling with missing health); left heal=false since it is a regen stat rather than an ability heal.

grim-exe.note: Displacement Blast only knocks back in Assault Mode; GTFO's 60% slow is on himself, correctly not parsed as CC.

grux.note: Stampede drags enemy heroes along its path; kept as 'pull'.

howitzer.note: R2000 Missile only hovers in place while charging (no relocation). Land Mine knocks back Howitzer too, which is his self-launch; tagged leap. Make It Rain lets him 'move freely' in the sky; left without a mobility tag as it is not a stated dash/leap.

ikra.note: Narcosis 'Suspends' (kept as knockup) for a stated duration. Hydroclasm has no mobility; only the Primarchs Eternal option of Herald makes popping it displace Ikra. Genesis knockup has no stated duration (1.25s is the slow after landing). Passive heal is Eternal-dependent (Dreadnoughts/Divines).

kaelen.note: Razorstorm's slow applies to Kaelen himself while casting, not to enemies.

kallari.note: Crippling Dagger is a thrown projectile with no movement. Shadow Walk passive health regen out of vision left as heal=false (regen stat).

khaimera.note: Cull's game description says 'Supresses' while the menu description says 'Stunning'; kept suppress with 1.25s.

kira.note: Purge's 30% slow is on Kira herself. heal on Mercy/Purge kept: they benefit from lifesteal but do not heal on their own.

legion.note: Frag Order 'Stunned' only describes Legion being stunned while cooking; launch applies to Legion or enemies (self-launch tagged leap). Passive only amplifies Saturation Charge slow and Rally Point heal, so its own slow/heal flags were removed.

lt-belica.note: Seismic Assault Innovation stun: menu says 1.4s, game description says 1.45s; used the menu value. Innovation applies at max rank.

maco.note: Maco Strike! sends the gem forward; Maco himself does not move. Maco Sparkle! stun scales with distance up to the stated max.

morigesh.note: Swarm grants decaying movement speed, not a dash, so mobility stays empty.

mourn.note: Beguile's slow only hits Mourn himself; its Mesmerize runs 0.45-1.2s by channel time, which the duration regex missed. Eclipse massively cuts enemy vision; no CC type fits, so it stays unlisted.

muriel.note: Sentinel only amplifies healing and shielding received; it grants no shield itself. Reversal of Fortune flies her to an allied hero anywhere, counted as teleport.

narbash.note: Crash Bang Boom's Mesmerize at max slow stacks gives no duration; hardSec 0.5 comes from the final-hit stun.

neon.note: Data Burst's Mesmerize only happens when Overclocked and its duration is not stated separately, so hardSec stays null. Final Thread's recast 'jumps upwards'; leap kept but it is mostly vertical.

phase.note: Telekinetic Link pulls her linked ALLY, not enemies, and 'Immobilized' is a condition, not a root. Psychic Flare only reduces Phase Blink's cooldown. Passive blink kept: it is her modified Phase Blink.

rampage.note: Pounce 'launches damaged Heroes backwards', read as knockback rather than knockup. Behemoth restores a share of max health per second, counted as self-heal.

renna.note: The passive only lets her hover and fall slowly after a mid-air jump; it is not a leap. Abyssal Rift kept as blink/teleport since text uses both words and gives no range.

riktor.note: Shock Therapy destroys ENEMY shields; the passive halts cooldowns on targets he immobilizes or silences and applies no CC itself.

scarlett.note: Minueta's stabs only benefit from item lifesteal, so no innate heal. Swan Song's backflip is unclear about where she lands, so no mobility added for R.

serath.note: Heaven's Fury makes her CC immune and invulnerable, counted as unstoppable. Ascend rises and dives down onto a target area, counted as leap.

sevarog.note: Subjugate chains enemies to its center for its duration (tether) and only stuns those who leave the zone.

skylar.note: Passive Dissonance only grants extra jump height; kept the parsed leap there but it is a passive jump boost, not an active reposition.

steel.note: Bull Rush's game_description says 'Stuns for 2s and Knocks Back Heroes', but menu text says heroes are Knocked Back and only Monsters and Minions are Stunned for 2s; read as knockback on heroes. Maintainer confirmed 2026-11-08: Bull Rush knocks heroes back; only minions and monsters are stunned.

terra.note: Unstoppable Force disables enemy towers, not heroes, so 'disable' removed from hard CC. Wild Rush game text says Knocks Back and Stuns but menu text only mentions the knockback; kept the parse.

wraith.note: Back It Up! teleports the enemy hero back via Limbo; no CC type fits cleanly, so hard left empty. Knock, Knock! only benefits from item lifesteal, so it is not an ability heal.

wukong.note: Wukong's basic abilities have empty game_description; corrections are from menu_description. RMB Body 'forcing away all enemies' read as knockback.

zarus.note: Barricade is described as 'unfold a shield' that reduces forward damage; it is damage reduction, not a health shield. Kept shield true as parsed.

zinx.note: Triage Protocol only boosts Infuse healing, so it is not a heal itself. Neural Regenesis resurrects with health but left heal false as parsed, since it is a revive.

rulings.2026-11-08: Maintainer: a shield absorbs damage as extra health; a spell shield blocks the next enemy ability; damage reduction cuts damage taken by a %. Boris has no spell shield (Primeval Roar is damage reduction). Steel Bull Rush: heroes knocked back, minions stunned.
